[b]Ministry of Foreign Affairs[/b]

[u]Regarding Developments in Astanir[/u]

[i]بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم [/i]

While we hope that the new so-called Peoples Republic of Astanir can improve the situation in the former Republic of Astanir, in shaa Allah, we still remain officially neutral in regards to the situation there. We once again urge all foreign parties to stop fueling the conflict, to put pressure on the forces they support to engage in a peace and reconciliation process, and for there to be an immediate ceasefire between the warring factions. Until the entire sovereign territory of what was once the Republic of Astanir is united, we will remain neutral.

[i]Abdoul Mahonomayi
Minister of Foreign Affairs
Islamic Sultanate of Baladullah[/i]
